topic: Disputing small medical collections after the 2023 rule change vs ignoring them (Wes vs Opal)

scenes.narration: Small medical collections cannot legally stay on credit reports anymore. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar holding a clipboard with a small bill stamped THREE EIGHTY SEVEN, comic burst banner reads RULE CHANGED IN 2023, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wes and Opal both have an old three hundred dollar medical collection.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man wes and woman opal each at kitchen tables with credit reports highlighting a red MEDICAL COLLECTION line, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both have ignored it since twenty nineteen, dragging their scores down.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a calendar flipping from 2019 to 2024, both wes and opal looking unhappy with falling score charts behind them, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wes assumes nothing changed and never disputes the collection.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, wes at a kitchen table tossing a credit report on a stack of mail, comic banner reads NOTHING I CAN DO, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: It sits on his report dragging his score down sixty points.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a score gauge with a red anchor labeled MEDICAL COLLECTION dragging the dial down by SIXTY POINTS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Opal learns about the new rule and files a dispute online.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, opal at a kitchen table on a laptop with a paper labeled NEW 2023 RULE beside her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She sends it to Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion the same day.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, three browser tabs labeled EQUIFAX EXPERIAN TRANSUNION open on a laptop, a dispute letter visible on each, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wes applies for a car loan at nine point eight percent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked wes at a car dealership desk holding a loan offer stamped NINE POINT EIGHT PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That higher rate costs three thousand more over the loan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, wes holding a loan summary with a red highlight reading THREE THOUSAND MORE INTEREST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thirty days later Opal's collection vanishes from all three reports.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, opal smiling at a phone showing three credit reports, each with the medical line stamped REMOVED in green, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her score jumps sixty two points and she gets five point nine.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, opal at a car desk holding a paper labeled FIVE POINT NINE PERCENT, score chart up by SIXTY TWO POINTS behind her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Pull your report. Dispute every small medical mark. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar holding a clipboard reading DISPUTE EVERY SMALL MEDICAL MARK, comic burst banner reads SEE YOU NEXT VISIT, kids comic book illustration
